mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO table_access_daily ( cluster_id, access_date, db_name, table_name, total_access_count, read_access_count, write_access_count, duration_sum_ms, duration_sample_count, first_access_time, last_access_time ) VALUES
( #{item.clusterId}, #{item.accessDate}, #{item.dbName}, #{item.tableName}, #{item.totalAccessCount}, #{item.readAccessCount}, #{item.writeAccessCount}, #{item.durationSumMs}, #{item.durationSampleCount}, #{item.firstAccessTime}, #{item.lastAccessTime} )
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE total_access_count = total_access_count + VALUES(total_access_count), read_access_count = read_access_count + VALUES(read_access_count), write_access_count = write_access_count + VALUES(write_access_count), duration_sum_ms = duration_sum_ms + VALUES(duration_sum_ms), duration_sample_count = duration_sample_count + VALUES(duration_sample_count), first_access_time = CASE WHEN first_access_time IS NULL THEN VALUES(first_access_time) WHEN VALUES(first_access_time) IS NULL THEN first_access_time ELSE LEAST(first_access_time, VALUES(first_access_time)) END, last_access_time = CASE WHEN last_access_time IS NULL THEN VALUES(last_access_time) WHEN VALUES(last_access_time) IS NULL THEN last_access_time ELSE GREATEST(last_access_time, VALUES(last_access_time)) END
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_access_count), 0) AS total_access_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN access_date >= #{recentStart} THEN total_access_count ELSE 0 END), 0) AS recent_access_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN access_date >= #{days7Start} THEN total_access_count ELSE 0 END), 0) AS access_count7d, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN access_date >= #{days30Start} THEN total_access_count ELSE 0 END), 0) AS access_count30d, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN access_date >= #{recentStart} THEN duration_sum_ms ELSE 0 END), 0) AS duration_sum_ms, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN access_date >= #{recentStart} THEN duration_sample_count ELSE 0 END), 0) AS duration_sample_count, MIN(first_access_time) AS first_access_time, MAX(last_access_time) AS last_access_time FROM table_access_daily WHERE cluster_id = #{clusterId} AND db_name = #{dbName} AND table_name = #{tableName} AND access_date >= #{totalStart}
